findings.evidence: `hmono` is used only at the last step (`hmono ?_`). Every other step of the proof uses `hiUnion`, through `exists_coord_bound_of_lt`.
findings.fix: Drop `hmono` from the signature and derive it from `hiUnion` inside the proof. The caller `exists_isPredictableTime_section_lt` then no longer needs to build `hI_mono`.
findings.issue: `exists_antitone_mem_of_lt_of_mem_souslinClosure` assumes `hmono : Monotone I`, but `hiUnion` already implies it. For `A ⊆ B`, apply `hiUnion` to the monotone sequence `A, B, B, …`: its union is `B`, so `I B = I A ⊔ I B ≥ I A`.

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Probability/Process/Stopping.lean:395 `theorem add_const [AddGroup ι] ...` and :409 `theorem add_const' ... [Countable ι]`. The PR proof has no `ℝ≥0`-specific step.
findings.fix: State it as `IsStoppingTime.add_const_of_orderedSub` with `[AddCommMonoid ι] [LinearOrder ι] [CanonicallyOrderedAdd ι] [Sub ι] [OrderedSub ι]` for any constant `c : ι`, and get the `ℝ≥0` uses by specialization.
findings.issue: `MeasureTheory.IsStoppingTime.add_const_nnreal` is stated only for `Filtration ℝ≥0 m`. Its proof uses only `tsub`, `le_tsub_iff_right`, `tsub_le_self` and `le_add_self`, so it holds in any canonically ordered type with ordered subtraction. Mathlib's `IsStoppingTime.add_const` needs `AddGroup ι` and `add_const'` needs `Countable ι`, so neither covers this case.

findings.evidence: `let trivFiltration : Filtration ℝ≥0 (⊤ : MeasurableSpace PUnit.{1}) := ...` appears in both `fallbackStep_properties` and `biInf_tendsto_and_lt`, and is used only for `.tendsto PUnit.unit` and `.monotone PUnit.unit`.

findings.issue: `fallbackStep_properties` and `biInf_tendsto_and_lt` build a dummy `trivFiltration` on `PUnit` just to reach the deterministic convergence facts inside `IsAnnouncingSequence.top` and `NNReal.isAnnouncingSequence_const`. Those facts don't depend on any filtration but are only available through filtration-indexed statements.

findings.evidence: Both proofs define the identical `G`, `hG_ae` and `hG_null`, then run the same `by_cases hω` blocks over `fallbackStep_properties`. Only the `heq` measurability step differs.
findings.fix: Prove one core lemma taking an exceptional set `N ⊇ Gᶜ` with `MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] N` and `∀ n t, MeasurableSet[ℱ t] (N ∩ {ω | fallbackStep n (τ ω) ≤ t})`. Derive both variants from it: the completeness one with `N := Gᶜ`, the null one with `N := toMeasurable P Gᶜ`.
findings.issue: `IsAEAnnouncingSequence.exists_isAnnouncingSequence_of_null` and `IsAEAnnouncingSequence.exists_isAnnouncingSequence` repeat the same construction: the good set `G`, `piecewise` with `fallbackStep`, and the same four-case verification. They differ only in how measurability of the exceptional piece is obtained.

summary: The Souslin capacity approximation theorem takes a hypothesis that follows from another of its hypotheses, and the stopping-time shift lemma is stated only for `ℝ≥0` although its proof needs only ordered subtraction. Two announcing-sequence upgrade lemmas repeat each other's proofs, and filtration-free pathwise facts are reached through a dummy filtration on `PUnit`.
